sloka: सो अहम् गुरु वचः कुर्वन् पृथिव्याम् न वसे निशाम् ।तदा प्रभृति काकुत्स्थ कृता मे काश्यपस्य ह ॥१-७६-१४॥
transliteration: so aham guru vacaḥ kurvan pṛthivyām na vase niśām ।tadā prabhṛti kākutstha kṛtā me kāśyapasya ha ॥1-76-14॥

translations.english: O Descendant of Kakustha having gifted this earth to Kasyapa, I promised him that I would not live here, during night time. For the earth belongs to him.
